resources.string: Sync finances to your Google account. You can share them with family later.
Your finances are not shared with family yet. Inviting someone gives them access to all existing finances in this workspace.
Finances on this phone belong to another Google account. Sign in with that account to continue syncing. They have not been uploaded to this account.
Family finances will replace finances on this phone. Your personal cloud data stays in a read-only archive and is not shared with the family. A copy of local data is kept for export.
Joining family. Your personal finances stay saved until the family data is ready.
Personal data saved before joining a family. Export an encrypted file to keep or restore it.
